name: Pro Time-Series Explorer
description: WebGL (deck.gl) time-series explorer for millions of points: in-house LTTB downsampling per visible window, stacked panels with a synced crosshair and tooltip, wheel/drag/keyboard zoom and pan, shift-drag zoom-to-selection, overview brush with slider handles, series toggles, annotations and range presets. Falls back to SVG without WebGL2.

props.name: series
props.description: Series with ascending epoch-ms timestamps and values (typed arrays recommended; NaN = gap), optional colour, unit and panel id

props.name: panels
props.description: Stacked panels sharing the time axis: id, title, height, formatValue, fixed yDomain

props.name: annotations
props.description: Point or band annotations (time, endTime, label, color, panel); clicking one zooms to it

props.name: range
props.description: Controlled visible window in epoch ms

props.name: defaultRange
props.description: Initial window when uncontrolled; defaults to the full extent

props.name: onRangeChange
props.description: Fires on zoom, pan, brush or preset

props.name: visibleSeries
props.description: Controlled visible series ids

props.name: defaultVisibleSeries
props.description: Initially visible series; all when omitted

props.name: onVisibleSeriesChange
props.description: Series toggle callback

props.name: presets
props.description: Range preset buttons anchored to the data end

props.name: density
props.description: Rendered points per pixel column after LTTB

props.name: renderer
props.description: Line renderer; auto uses WebGL2 when available

props.name: minSpan
props.description: Smallest zoom window in ms

props.name: showOverview
props.description: Show the overview brush strip

props.name: loading
props.description: Skeleton state

props.name: error
props.description: Error message

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when there are no samples

props.name: onAnnotationClick
props.description: Annotation click callback

props.name: title
props.description: Header title

props.name: className
props.description: Root class names

usage: Pass typed arrays for large series. Drag to pan, Shift+drag to zoom to a selection, scroll to zoom around the cursor, double-click or Home to reset. Keyboard: arrows pan, +/- zoom, Shift+arrows move the crosshair.
